title: The Chamber of Whispers
alt: Blue and golden whisper trails curl around Ethan and Leo inside a round chamber of glowing carvings.
caption: The chamber's ancient whispers gather around the brothers like streams of light.

title: The Hidden Altar
alt: Ethan and Leo discover a black stone altar glowing with spiral symbols in a hidden cavern room.
caption: A hidden altar waits at the heart of the island's memory.

title: The Offering
alt: Ethan and Leo place their glowing map together above the spiral-lit altar.
caption: The brothers choose to offer the map together rather than sacrifice one another's trust.

title: The Keeper's Judgment
alt: A towering blue star-filled Keeper rises above the altar as Ethan and Leo face its judgment.
caption: The ancient Keeper arrives to judge whether Ethan and Leo are worthy.

title: The Keeper's Verdict
alt: Ethan and Leo clasp hands before a gentle golden Keeper who reaches toward them above the altar.
caption: Standing together earns the brothers the Keeper's glowing verdict.

title: The Keeper's Gift
alt: Ethan and Leo reach together for a glowing stone tablet while the calm Keeper watches behind them.
caption: The Keeper reveals a luminous stone tablet for the brothers to carry together.

title: The Path Revealed
alt: Ethan and Leo step through a carved doorway toward a glowing spiral path and crystal valley.
caption: The Keeper's gift reveals a new path through the island and into the adventure beyond.
